svg.text: Best fix: a non-blocking driver (R2DBC, reactive Mongo/Redis, WebClient). boundedElastic is a workaround.

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', 'Chalkboard SE', cursive

svg.text: Catch it in tests with BlockHound: it throws BlockingOperationError when a non-blocking thread blocks.
